$comment: Known high/critical npm advisories tolerated by `npm run check:audit` (BASE-03, ADR-0021). Every entry needs a reason, the backlog item that removes it and an expiry date: after that date the gate fails again. Moderate/low advisories are reported but never fail the gate.

advisories.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs (high, 2026-10-19). No patched version exists: <= 4.0.7 is affected and 4.0.7 is the latest. Only in development tooling (vite, vitest, jest, lint-staged, tinyglobby, @wdio/session; dev: true in both lockfiles), never in the installer or the production server; the globs it parses are ours, not user input.
